jsonld_raw.name: EBONY WOOD EDP 100ML (3.4 FL.OZ).
jsonld_raw.description:
EBONY WOOD EDP 100ML (3.4 FL.OZ). Capture the moment of achievement and personal celebration: the confidence of someone who has just reached a milestone and is ready for the next step. The brightness of grapefruit opens with energy and determination, while cypress and pink pepper add structure and character. At the heart, coffee introduces a contemporary, almost introspective depth that settles on a base of warm and elegant patchouli and vetiver.

A collection created by Ms. Jo Malone CBE, founder of Jo Loves.

Woody spicy | Magnetic, structured, and elegant
